items.memo:
BILL NUMBER: S3205

SPONSOR: HELMING
 
TITLE OF BILL:

An act to amend the environmental conservation law, in relation to
providing free lifetime licenses for honorably discharged, disabled
veterans

 
PURPOSE:

This bill provides for lifetime sportsman licenses for honorably
discharged disabled veterans without an annual renewal.

 
SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:

Section 1: Amends Subdivision 1 of section 11-0702 of the Environmental
Conservation Law to allow honorably discharged veterans who have a
permanent disability to have a lifetime sportsman license without a fee
and annual renewal.

Section 2: Provides an immediate effective date.

 
JUSTIFICATION:

Current law allows disabled veterans to purchase an annual sportsman
license for a five-dollar fee. This act would eliminate the need for
annual renewal by allowing disabled veterans to acquire a lifetime
sportsman license for no fee and no annual renewal. Given the personal
sacrifices our disabled veterans have made, allowing them to enjoy hunt-
ing, fishing and outdoor activities in New York for life without the
requirement to annually renew and without cost, is a small gesture for
their service to our nation.

2017: S.2579 referred to Veterans, Homeland Security and Military

2014: S.7469 referred to Veterans, Homeland Security and Military
Affairs
 
FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:

To be determined.

 
EFFECTIVE DATE:
This Act will take effect immediately.
